cut_rhythm.pattern: One continuous 39.3 s motion-graphic canvas, zero detected cuts. Content swaps every ~2-6 s inside the same frame (search box, phone mock-up, VS Code window, site map, invoice, comment thread) with one word-by-word caption line under it.

shots.camera_angle: none: flat designed graphics, no camera
shots.composition: centered single card, vertically stacked: logo top, content card mid, caption lower third, footer links near bottom

transitions.note: no cuts: card swap inside one canvas, old card slides up + blur-fades while new card scales/fades in; progress dots advance

elements.easing: ease-out / soft spring settle on card entry, slight overshoot on pills (judged from frame positions)

motion.notes: animated numeric counters (stars count up), bar growth, scan beam, cursor flights; real 2D motion graphics, not stills with zoom

text.role: word-by-word caption + card titles + big numeral
text.position: caption centered ~63% of frame height; footer links ~81%
text.animation_in: each new word blur-to-sharp fade-in (blurred 1-2 words trailing at line end); key words in green highlight box (e.g. "fastest")
text.animation_out: whole caption line blur-fades out between sentences
text.safe_zone_note: caption at ~63% is just above the strict bottom 35% line; footer links at ~81% are inside strict bottom zone but outside hard 14.6% zone

grade.look: clean light UI: near-white background, deep emerald-green accent gradients, soft green glow blobs, black code windows; no film grade

layout.safe_zones: logo top ~5%; content card 12-45%; caption ~63%; footer ~81%
layout.framing_notes: top: "sansser /" wordmark centred; bottom footer: heysansser | sansser (YouTube) | /sansser.com; screen-recording/UI shown as cards inside the canvas
